categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet import and scan logic in src/wallet/imports.cpp and src/wallet/scan.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a wallet recovery bug where interrupted descriptor imports falsely reported success while leaving transactions missing. As noted in the description, when shutdown interrupts `importdescriptors`, 'the wallet's best block is already at the tip, so nothing rescans on the next start, and the transactions stay missing until a manual rescanblockchain.' Correcting silent rescan omissions directly addresses wallet recovery correctness and wrong balances.
